description: This file defines the CustomFieldAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint implementation for managing custom fields in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting custom fields, along with validation rules, and documentation annotations for API specifications.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPI
classes.description: A class providing REST API endpoints for managing custom fields within the OrangeHRM PIM module, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and API documentation.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of CustomFieldService used for business logic related to custom fields.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field by its ID, returning the data formatted as CustomFieldModel.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all custom fields with support for sorting and pagination, returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field, enforcing a maximum of 10 fields, and returns the created field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field specified by ID, with validation and conditional logic for related data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes custom fields provided by ID array, ensuring they are not in use.

methods.name: setCustomField
methods.description: Sets properties of a CustomField entity from request parameters.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Persists a CustomField entity using the service's DAO.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing custom fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting custom fields.

methods.name: setBodyParameters
methods.description: Collects and returns body parameters for processing, like name, type, screen, extraData.
